The structure of Mg12Cu2Ir2 (Mg6CuIr) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Cu and Ir centers each have 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have 12 neighbors (4 Cu, 4 Ir, 4 Mg), with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.97–3.21 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts among 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns, though these do not assert an exclusive sharing type for all polyhedra.
